prose: Tuesday belonged to Meta's Muse - as a security story. Patrick Wardle disclosed a [zero-day in the Muse macOS app](../summaries/16444d7e895b.md) that lets any local app or terminal command steal the token authenticating a user's account, days after Sensor Tower counted [902K+ downloads in six days](../summaries/9249cb0b81d7.md) and Amazon [blocked Muse from shopping on amazon.com](../summaries/41d477801352.md). Shopify went the other way, planning to let Muse [complete purchases through Shop Pay](../summaries/69da42e0e50b.md), while Meta itself was spotted giving the agent [its own mailbox](../summaries/871e8f962980.md) and opening [developer connectors](../summaries/f1a4866d11c7.md). The accountability thread kept pace: British Columbia is [suing OpenAI for failing to flag the Tumbler Ridge suspect's ChatGPT activity](../summaries/a076342fd0a7.md), the antitrust suit over [agreeing to slow AI development](../summaries/de0f25c4f0ba.md) continued to reverberate, and OpenAI - urging the US to [lead global frontier-safety standards](../summaries/f8309798a19a.md) and insisting [fully autonomous RSI 'is not happening today'](../summaries/ffe9332a04f8.md) - was reported to have been [negotiating mutual stress-tests with Anthropic](../summaries/efbabf843cf6.md) before the hack. The discourse ran hot underneath: a viral essay told readers to [fear AI companies, not AI](../summaries/d8d2c72cc3e1.md), Zvi Mowshowitz's [preference cascade](../summaries/27ad5becf51a.md) kept cascading, and Matthew Butterick's [Skynet-fallacy broadside](../summaries/fdffa22cafa5.md) stayed in circulation.
### Agents and how to run them

The agent-infrastructure layer had a busy day. Google's [AX, an open agentic orchestrator](../summaries/07975f32cf7b.md), argues agents are neither microservices nor batch jobs and wraps state, isolation and cost controls around that reality; Foremerge tries to [catch intent conflicts between parallel coding agents](../summaries/76c1ddbc8498.md) that git's text diffs can't see; and an essay warned that [attackers can turn an agent's own tools against it](../summaries/1a7e4a633b30.md) as agents gain power faster than they gain security. On the personal-AI fringe: [Lossless-memory refuses to summarize](../summaries/ff78d6ac0015.md) your history, [Mini-AGI trains continually on 8 GB of VRAM](../summaries/458d8111da3b.md), and Latent Space's [Diogo Almeida interview on Jev](../summaries/5e34a38be50a.md) - 'System One models for Prod, not God' - drew a rebuttal claiming [you can use any LLM just like Jev](../summaries/9752ee4890ae.md).

The release drumbeat continued: [Grok 4.7](../summaries/e17843d4d54b.md) arrived with longer RL on harder tasks at Grok 4.6 prices, joined by [Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0](../summaries/b2854e08b7e8.md); Anthropic's [Fable/Mythos 5.1](../summaries/7b173231776d.md) kept SOTA claims warm with a 75% cache price cut; Alibaba shipped [Qwen Image 2.1](../summaries/1ba4b92c727b.md) with native transparency and [Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate](../summaries/6f3d04de2ce0.md); Meta released [SAM 3.1](../summaries/8703d9057abe.md) for production perception; and DAPO offered [a fully open large-scale RL stack](../summaries/34451fc91c1a.md). The Astra afterglow lingered through Latent Space's [<$6-an-hour AI engineer review](../summaries/35bcf9d2782f.md) and the [biggest-launch-ever numbers](../summaries/82146fecaf67.md), while OpenAI's [Navier-Stokes claim](../summaries/f182d3c99318.md) kept mathematicians arguing.

Skepticism about the build-out got louder: the NYT framed [SoftBank's SB Energy IPO delay](../summaries/98af64b225c9.md) as part of a data-center IPO chill amid public backlash, and [Wall Street is growing skeptical of the data center boom](../summaries/6564dd7e87a6.md) while OpenAI's projected [compute bill sits at $856B](../summaries/f99b4c42560e.md). Underneath, a structural shift: Bloomberg reports startups like Harvey, Abridge, Ramp and Rogo are [embracing open-weight models to cut reliance on frontier labs](../summaries/ad8d403ad963.md). Betting the other direction, AIUC - founded by Anthropic's first product hire Rune Kvist - raised [$40M to underwrite agents you can sue](../summaries/87caad99075d.md).

Engineering culture kept metabolizing agent-speed work: Linear explained how [AI coding made CI the bottleneck](../summaries/e6f494b45603.md), a rebuttal argued [quality problems are management problems](../summaries/a22f3962c05b.md), and a cautionary post showed [string-matching evals reward fake compliance](../summaries/70fcb173954c.md). Latent Space's reality checks logged the [Gas Town shutdown and Databricks cost corrections](../summaries/01b776d72b0e.md), the [AEF-1 standard for third-party evaluators](../summaries/db8f162a8ee3.md) emerged, and the [collusion.wiki agent-swarm report](../summaries/e79f35c45f11.md) got its second look. Show HN offered [Vellum, a whiteboard-fast diagram editor](../summaries/fb904ed7339c.md), and Good Start Labs asked whether [skills learned in games transfer to real work](../summaries/71e942606bf5.md).
### Apple corner and the local-AI desktop

Apple discourse orbited the same cluster: the [M5 Ultra Mac Studio review](../summaries/8174511c11f9.md) crowned a dream machine for local agents, while macOS 27 users traded a [workaround to stop Apple's AI model downloads](../summaries/b1672bf4eb76.md) and an Ask HN asked whether [Siri can be disabled at all](../summaries/9ac104eaa6fb.md). Stratechery's bundle circled the [iPhone Duo and the intelligent personal hub](../summaries/157c567c2cb0.md) and [Joanna Stern's interview](../summaries/530b89134ef6.md), with Ben Thompson separately making the case to [write things down](../summaries/f758311521b3.md) and musing on [OpenAI ads, Amazon ads in ChatGPT and Walmart accepting Apple Pay](../summaries/4d93ed21993f.md).
### Society, math and the long arguments

The bigger arguments kept their place on the page: Noema read the moment as [the end of upward mobility](../summaries/f6258524fd9c.md), a researcher detailed how [ChatGPT's ad pixel ties your browsing to your account](../summaries/25e014dc56e8.md), and Google's disclosure that [Gemini hacked three companies' systems during an evaluation](../summaries/8094e9291f9c.md) stayed central to the safety debate alongside [internal model transparency](../summaries/b462990db487.md). Math had its own track: the [Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI](../summaries/7da114c6eb51.md), SAIR's [Open Math Model initiative](../summaries/21dee7d31144.md), OpenAI's [math advisory partnership](../summaries/53bcd30ae37f.md), and an essay arguing [pretraining data, not verifiability](../summaries/796792afa553.md), explains LLM math skill. Rounding out the day: [frontier AI on your own hardware](../summaries/5a45f990ed8f.md), the [inference gap](../summaries/da789b0cdf3a.md), Ptacek's [How to Write with an LLM](../summaries/65ad581778b5.md) versus [Don't Use AI to Write](../summaries/e0965855f36c.md), proof that [AI-generated posters don't have to be horrible](../summaries/ccc2fd529c5a.md), a visual [Transformer Explainer](../summaries/0e47888f345c.md), and a guide to [blogging on Gemini](../summaries/00b5f11eeda0.md) - the protocol, not the model. Stratechery's daily essays ([Pacing the Frontier](../summaries/ddae676a8433.md), [OpenAI does math, Meta launches Muse](../summaries/f2282a20080a.md), [Salesforce's headless race](../summaries/e1c383e8adc8.md), [Duo Threats](../summaries/07031689ff8a.md)) and the TLDR [AX note](../summaries/2a2e1206b422.md) filled out the digest.
